units.text: EXT. DRIVE-IN THEATER - NIGHT
A cracked asphalt lot facing a huge cream-colored screen.
Speaker poles stand in rows like metal weeds.
Fireflies drift between them.
A projector shaft glows over a concession hut.
The film is a silent black-and-white western, its dust-lit figures galloping over the clouds.
TESS BRANNIGAN, seventeen, sits cross-legged on the hood of a dented pickup, wrapped in an oversized flannel.
Her hair is pulled up in a loose knot.
She keeps picking at a sticker on her water bottle.
JOSE ALVARADO-CHEN, seventeen, sits beside her, lanky and awkward, his knees too high, one sneaker untied.
He eats popcorn with the intensity of someone avoiding a conversation.
MARCELLO, eighteen, Tess's brother, leans against the driver's door with a cigarette he has not lit.
He looks at the sky, then at the screen, then at his sister.
DELIA, sixteen, Jose's cousin, perches on the tailgate swinging her legs.
He said he'd be here by nine.
units.name: TESS

units.text: It's only nine-fifteen.
units.name: JOSE

units.text: It's nine-twenty.
units.name: TESS

units.text: He offers her popcorn.
She takes a piece, doesn't eat it.
Marcello clears his throat.
You want me to call him?
units.name: MARCELLO

units.text: No.
units.name: TESS

units.text: He lights the cigarette.
Delia kicks the tailgate.
The projector flickers, a reel jumps, and the galloping horses stutter and freeze.
A scratchy loudspeaker voice crackles from the concession hut.
Folks, sorry for the delay. Reel two will be right up. In the meantime, enjoy the stars.
units.name: CONCESSION VOICE

units.text: Everyone looks up.
The stars are thick, cold, indifferent.
Pretty.
units.name: DELIA

units.text: I could wait with you. If you want.
units.name: JOSE

units.text: You don't have to.
units.name: TESS

units.text: I know.
units.name: JOSE

units.text: He slides a little closer on the hood.
She does not move away.
Marcello watches them, then turns his back and stares at the screen.
The film jerks to life.
The horses gallop again, and nobody in the truck says a word until the credits.
